name: Star Crossed
source:
Congratulations! You are the first human to star in Intergalactic Hit Reality TV Show, Star Crossed! (Viewable exclusively on channel U.F.O.) We’ll beam you up for a chance to find love with our Dreamy Orbiters!

Follow that gravitational pull to the hottest extraterrestrial, or crash and burn! Be careful not to get Frisa-Eggz-ed... 

[Edited from [url=https://ufo-studios.itch.io/star-crossed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！你是第一个在星际热门真人秀电视节目《星十字》中担任主角的人类！（仅可在U.F.O. 频道上观看）我们将让你有机会与我们的梦幻轨道飞行器一起寻找爱情！

跟随引力到达最热门的外星生物，否则就会崩溃！小心不要被Frisa-Eggz-ed… 

[编辑自[url=https://ufo-studios.itch.io/star-crossed]itch.io[/url]]
